new_candidates.requirement: Exercise the decoder’s rewritten gamma LUT behavior for RGBA8 by enabling SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA on the existing decode operation.
new_candidates.target_route: A finite 1×1 RGB8 PNG containing an IHDR, a four-byte gAMA chunk, a compressed one-pixel IDAT scanline and an IEND passes the harness’s size checks. Parsing stores gamma state; decode with the gamma flag would initialize and use the local LUT.
new_candidates.failure_condition: The sole harness decode call passes SPNG_DECODE_USE_TRNS (1), while the gamma guard requires SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA (2). No input bytes can change that call argument.
new_candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry has one decode call, no flag selection from input and no other call sequence that enables gamma. A gAMA chunk alone sets stored state but cannot satisfy the separate flag guard.
